title: Canonical embedded integral-model coefficients and predicates
statement: For a prime ell and finite embedded coefficient field E, define the discrete scalar ring sheaf and its canonical constant-function map to the continuous ring sheaf; pull these to the pro-etale site of X. Define exact derived restriction, completeness by the existing local quotient-kernel ideal predicate, and the Stacks criterion by completeness, constructible residue cohomology and finite Tor amplitude. Define residue etale origin using the specified intrinsic realization, with finite and discrete residue witnesses. These are exactly the definitions formerly attached to [sk-lem-integral-models], moved with explicit inferred result types and the already-required K-injective proof instance, without changing the mathematical constructions.
